notes.title: Episode 3: The Buzzing of the Flies
notes.notes:
Just in time to celebrate the spookiest (and best) month of the year, FLIES FLIES FLIES is back with episode 3: "The Buzzing of the Flies."

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/8csJzq5r/episode3-alt-alt.png[/img]

Does the poster look familiar? It's an homage to my favorite horror movie, which was the main inspiration for episode 3.

Happy (almost) Halloween!

notes.title: Free Demo Launch
notes.notes:
If you've been on the fence about buying FLIES FLIES FLIES, here's something to help you make the right choice: a free demo! This demo contains the complete first episode of the 6-episode season. I hope you like it.

And if you've already played & enjoyed FLIES FLIES FLIES, please consider sharing the free demo with all of your weirdest friends! <3

notes.title: The first 2 episodes are live!
notes.notes:
The first 2 episodes, "Flylot" and "Robofinn", are now available! To celebrate their launch, the season pass for FLIES FLIES FLIES is 33% off until December 8. For just $4.01 you will be able to experience all 6 episodes as we make them!

The road to get here has been long and hard. We're extremely excited for you to see what we've been working on. Check it out, write a review if you can, and tell your friends!

Episode 3 coming soon.

--Nat
